---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or feature for PenguinGit Lens
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

**Is this already on the roadmap?**
Check [ROADMAP.md](../../docs/ROADMAP.md) first. If it's already planned, comment on the existing issue with extra context instead of duplicating it.

**What's the feature?**
A clear description of what you want to happen and what problem it solves.

**How does GitLens / PenguinGit Desktop do this today (if applicable)?**
If this clones or complements an existing GitLens or PenguinGit feature, describe the behavior.

**Proposed approach (optional)**
If you have thoughts on implementation (VS Code extension API, webview UI, new Engine RPC call), share them here.

**Additional context**
Anything else relevant.
